hooks.command: unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE; ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && if [ -f "$ROOT/scripts/session-context.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/scripts/session-context.py"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/../scripts/session-context.py" ]; then python3 "$ROOT/../scripts/session-context.py"; else echo "Workspace context unavailable; establish the coordinated lane" >&2; exit 1; fi
